CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-verdict-item-barrier, at head 1beed40bfefac3265b2c2dd8551a0b51d47f9ade. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 1beed40bfefac3265b2c2dd8551a0b51d47f9ade for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-verdict-item-barrier, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-verdict-item-barrier <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-verdict-item-barrier; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer seat, topic r10-verdict-item-barrier (owner-approved 2026-10-21: "do that"). A recurring defect: three merge verdicts (#2513 review 6314156311 item 3b97e1aa, #2544 review 6314170570 item aeeb9432, #2547 review 6315224098 item b579380b) were parked by the merge train's pre-flight because tools/audit/seat/carry_audit.py read evidence or note sections of a reviewer's merge verdict ("Mutation proof re-run ...", "**CI on this head** ...", "Forward-carry: the body's none holds ...") as finding items lacking a `Carry:`. Build a barrier at the source, with two parts:
(1) In tools/audit/seat/cloud_dispatch.py, change the reviewer prompt so the verdict format separates findings from evidence. Every finding item carries its own `Carry:` line, and evidence or notes go under a heading carry_audit is defined to skip (read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md for the verdict format, and keep within it). Note that open PR #2556 (head 1beed40bfefac3265b2c2dd8551a0b51d47f9ade, fix/r10-cloud-rev-head-ev) also edits this prompt: build on top of #2556's head, merging it in, never rebasing, and say in the body that this lands after #2556.
(2) In carry_audit.py, make the classification match: an item under the evidence heading is not a finding, so it needs no Carry. Owner's rule, verbatim: "A pr still needs valid evidence". So do not weaken the evidence requirement. If carry_audit or the relay checks evidence validity, keep that, and do not let a heading become a way to smuggle an unrouted finding past the check: a finding-shaped item (a defect claim) under the evidence heading must still be caught. State how you detect that.
fixer.md steps 2-8: failing tests first, replaying the three real verdict comments as fixtures (fetch their text read-only with gh api), plus a mutation proof and a null control (a verdict with a real unrouted finding is still refused). Decision 0012 moratorium: no new policy file or lint class; this is a correction to an existing check. If the change touches the role file's verdict format, that is policy, so say so in the body. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
